overview: 35 official Qs (2008: 7, 2012: 1, 2017: 10, 2019: 7, 2024: 1, 2025: 9). Mostly one-liners (24 with options, 5 stem-only); 2025 brought matching (2), chronology, statement and negative Qs. Exact dates of the 1952–53 events, Mahasabha presidents/places, Sribagh and newspaper founders recur; several keys conflict with app notes.

possibility.angle: Origin and growth of the Andhra movement (B.N. Sarma resolution, Andhra University, Sribagh Pact, Madras premiers)
possibility.what_they_ask: Year of a resolution or pact, where Sribagh was, AU's first HQ, which Madras CM opposed a separate state

possibility.angle: Andhra and Rayalaseema Mahasabhas (sessions, presidents, places)
possibility.what_they_ask: President of the first (1913 Bapatla) and later sessions, president in 1941–46, place of Rayalaseema Mahasabha sessions

possibility.angle: Prominent leaders (titles and why they got them)
possibility.what_they_ask: The event behind a leader's title (Prakasam – Simon boycott 1928)

possibility.angle: Events leading to Andhra State 1953 (fasts, commissions, committees, capital, High Court)
possibility.what_they_ask: Exact dates of the fast/death/formation, who chaired which commission/committee, chronology 1948–53, HC and capital seats, who ended a fast on whose appeal

possibility.angle: Press and newspapers in the Andhra movement
possibility.what_they_ask: Paper → founder/editor, which paper backed Home Rule or demanded a separate government, wrong-match in paper–editor pairs, author of articles
Founder, place and year of libraries/granthalayas, periodicals, boat library

possibility.evidence: 2 Qs: 2019×2; many related Qs in other APPSC exams on Burrakatha, Kuchipudi, crafts
possibility.what_they_ask: Place → craft (Etikoppaka), dance form → exponent (Kuravanji – Rukmini Devi)

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs; asked in other APPSC exams (Medaram Jathara, Modakondamma Jatara as state festival 2016)
possibility.what_they_ask: Natural targets: tribal festivals and their places, tribal dances such as Dhimsa (Araku), major tribes and their regions – in 'place → item' one-liners

traps.spot: Four consecutive dates [17–20 Oct 1952] or 1953 vs 1956 formation dates
traps.fix: Fast began 19 Oct 1952; death 15 Dec 1952; Andhra State 1 Oct 1953; Andhra Pradesh 1 Nov 1956
traps.pyq: 'fast unto death … on' → 19 October 1952 [group2-2008-paper2#11]; 'Andhra State was formed on' → 1 Oct 1953, 1 Nov 1956 is AP [mains-2025-paper1#68]

traps.spot: Options list Vandemataram, NCM, Simon, Quit India
traps.fix: Andhra Kesari came from facing police at the Simon Commission boycott, 1928
traps.pyq: 'Andhra Kesari for bravery during' → Boycott of Simon Commission [group2-2008-paper2#12]; same in [group2-2012-paper1#149]

traps.trap: Chairman of one commission given for another
traps.spot: Dhar, Fazal Ali, JVP members and Partition Committee names together
traps.fix: Dhar Commission 1948 (S.K. Dhar); JVP Dec 1948–Apr 1949 (Nehru, Patel, Pattabhi); Partition Committee chair Kumaraswamy Raja; SRC 1953 (Fazal Ali)
traps.pyq: 'Linguistic Provinces Commission … year and chair' → 1948, S.K. Dhar, not Fazal Ali [prelims-2024#79]; 'Partition Committee chairman' → Kumaraswamy Raja, Prakasam was a member [mains-2025-paper1#42]

traps.spot: Kurnool and Guntur both offered for one of the two
traps.fix: Andhra State 1953: capital Kurnool, High Court Guntur
traps.pyq: 'High Court of Andhra State' → Guntur, Kurnool was the capital [group2-2008-paper2#51]

traps.trap: Place/year of an institution swapped with another of the same movement
traps.spot: Library statement with Kovvur 1916 or Hyderabad 1901
traps.fix: Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam = Hyderabad 1901 (Komarraju Lakshmana Rao)
traps.pyq: 'SKDABN was established in Kovvur in 1916' → false [mains-2025-paper1#40]

traps.trap: Founder vs editor of a paper
traps.spot: Paper–person pairs with founders and editors mixed
traps.fix: Krishna Patrika: founded by Konda Venkatappayya, edited by Mutnuri; Andhra Prakasika = A.P. Parthasarathi Naidu; Andhra Patrika = Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao (1908)
traps.pyq: 'Andhra Prakasika – P. Anandacharlu' → wrong match, it was Parthasarathi Naidu [mains-2019-paper2#51]

traps.trap: Madras premier of a different term
traps.spot: Justice Party premiers listed with the year 1932
traps.fix: Panagal 1921–26, Subbarayan 1926–30, Munuswamy Naidu 1930–32, Raja of Bobbili 1932–37
traps.pyq: 'opposed separate state once he became CM of Madras in 1932' → Bobbili Raja [mains-2017-paper2#56]

techniques.name: 1948–1956 date ladder
techniques.how: Write the ladder [Dhar 1948, JVP 1949, Visalandhra Mahasabha 1949, Sitaram fast 1951, Sriramulu fast 1952, Andhra State 1953, SRC 1953, AP 1956] and slot each item.
techniques.example: B (Dhar 1948) → A (Visalandhra Mahasabha) → C (Sitaram 1951) → D (SRC 1953) → 'B, A, C, D' [mains-2025-paper1#30]

techniques.name: Anchor the first session
techniques.how: In session-president matching, lock the first session (1913 Bapatla – B.N. Sarma) and keep only codes with it.
techniques.example: a-III (Baiya Narasimheswara Sharma) appears only in 'a-III, b-II, c-IV, d-I' [mains-2025-paper1#36]

techniques.name: Statement elimination with one sure false
techniques.how: Find one statement you can falsify; drop all options containing it.
techniques.example: III (SKDABN at Kovvur 1916) is false → only 'I, II, IV only' survives [mains-2025-paper1#40]

techniques.name: Role word check (chair, member, founder, editor)
techniques.how: Underline the role in the stem; famous names who were only members or editors fall away.
techniques.example: Partition Committee 'Chairman' → Kumaraswamy Raja; Prakasam and Sanjiva Reddy were members [mains-2025-paper1#42]

techniques.name: Person-to-episode recall
techniques.how: Tie each leader to one unique episode (Sabarmati, 1951 fast, Simon boycott) and match.
techniques.example: 'worked with Gandhi in Sabarmati Ashram' → Potti Sriramulu; Swami Sitaram is the 1951 fast [mains-2017-paper2#60]

confusions.remember: 1953 = Kurnool capital, Guntur HC; 1956 = merger with Telangana, Hyderabad
Sitaram ended his on Vinoba Bhave's appeal; Sriramulu died on 15 Dec 1952 after 58 days
Dhar 1948 (advised against linguistic states then); JVP = Nehru, Patel, Pattabhi 1949
Bapatla 1913 = B.N. Sarma (first Andhra Mahasabha); Rayalaseema Mahasabha began 1934
Pact 16 Nov 1937; Sribagh = Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao's house in Madras
Andhra Patrika 1908 = Kasinathuni; Krishna Patrika 1902 = Konda Venkatappayya (editor Mutnuri)
Crescent = Gazulu Lakshminarasu Chetty; Desha Matha = Home Rule paper in Andhra
Komarraju = SKDABN 1901; Madapati = first Andhra Mahasabha (Nizam state) 1930
Both wooden/lacquer toys; Etikoppaka asked as 'wooden craft' (2019)
Kuravanji exponent asked = Rukmini Devi Arundale; Kuchipudi = AP classical dance

anchors: 1913 Bapatla – first Andhra Mahasabha, president B.N. Sarma
1918 – B.N. Sarma's resolution on linguistic provinces in the Central Legislative Assembly
1926 – Andhra University, first HQ Bezawada (later Waltair)
1928 – Simon boycott: Prakasam becomes Andhra Kesari
1951 – Swami Sitaram's fast, ended on Vinoba Bhave's appeal
19 Oct 1952 fast began – 15 Dec 1952 Potti Sriramulu died
1 Oct 1953 – Andhra State; capital Kurnool, High Court Guntur
1901 – Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam, Hyderabad (Komarraju Lakshmana Rao)
1915 – Grandhalaya Sarvasvam periodical; 1918 – boat library (Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao)
checklist: Place the event on the 1913–1956 ladder before reading options.
Separate 1953 Andhra State from 1956 Andhra Pradesh facts.
Is the stem asking chair, member, founder or editor?
For institutions, check place and year together – APPSC swaps the pair.
For key-conflict facts (first Telugu newspaper, Rayalaseema session places), read all options and pick the one the stem's wording points to.
